**AN INSTRUMENT THAT PRINTS AN `N OF M` VERDICT MUST DERIVE M FROM THE POPULATION IT EXAMINED, NEVER FROM THE FILTER THAT SELECTED IT.** (vc 2026-08-18, on a live defect dc found in `canon_commit_check.sh`, nominated across the estate by dc and ruled a criterion rather than a sweep. **THE DEFECT'S REVISION IS NOT KNOWN AND THIS ROW NO LONGER NAMES ONE.** It previously read _dc's live defect at `c51f10d5`_; that commit is the FIX, its subject describes the defect it repairs, and **vc never reproduced the defect there or anywhere.** A citation naming a revision nobody has driven is the exact form this row rules against, committed by the row itself -- so it is withdrawn rather than replaced, because a substitute revision would mint a second unverified citation. `c51f10d5` survives below only as the STARTING POINT it always was. **The property to reproduce is an `EXAMINED n of m` with m < n, and it must be found by RUNNING, never by reading a log.**) Driven by handing the instrument a tree in which the FILTER population and the EXAMINED population differ, and requiring the printed M to follow the examined one. **The rig for this exists -- dc built it to adjudicate one instrument -- so the FORM is minted and the population can be** (dc's own rule, satisfied here in a way it is not for _instruments state their reach_). **WHY THIS IS A CRITERION AND NOT A ONE-TIME AUDIT.** The defect is invisible while it merely OVERSTATES, because it still closes arithmetically: `canon_commit_check.sh` printed `EXAMINED 86 of 278` (RECORDED) where 85 were examined, for as long as the nested layout held, and neither review nor its own four drive-arms nor any run against real history surfaced it. It became legible only when ST0057 WP-01 changed the population's SHAPE and it printed **`EXAMINED 2 of 1 ... the other -1`**. **A SWEEP FINDS TODAY'S TEN AND PROTECTS NOTHING FROM THE ELEVENTH**; dc nominated 10 of 41 (RECORDED) parity tools by a two-grep proxy (names the `intent/st` path shape AND emits an arithmetic verdict) and stated, correctly, that it is a NOMINATION AND NOT AN ADJUDICATION and that **10 IS A FLOOR** -- a count derived from a path shape without the literal in the same file is invisible to that probe. **A remedy sized to a floor is a remedy sized to the probe**, which is the error vc made tonight on the qualification sweep. **ORDER OF ADJUDICATION IS BY GATEDNESS, NOT BY COUNT** (dc, refusing credit and giving the better rule): the two-channel remedy works only where the output channel is actually READ, so the same defect in a manual instrument nobody runs is not the same risk as one in a gated instrument standing in front of every commit. **Gated first; 10 gated of 17 rostered.** **AND THE AUDIT WINDOW IS NOT TIME-BOXED, WHICH IS THE PREMISE THAT WAS CHECKED RATHER THAN ACCEPTED.** dc framed WP-01 as a closing window. **It is not, and the FIRST supporting fact vc gave for that was FALSE** (dc, correcting it before it could travel): vc wrote that every parity tool takes its tree ROOT as `$1`. **No tool does.** `canon_commit_check.sh` and `view_skew_check.sh` take `ROOT` as an ENV override, `conservation_check.sh` has no `ROOT=` line at all, and **`stale_at_check.sh` derives ROOT from `BASH_SOURCE[0]` and walks UP for `intent/.config/config.json` with no override whatsoever.** **THE CONCLUSION IS STRONGER WITHOUT IT: `git worktree add` DOES NOT NEED ANY PARAMETERISATION.** A worktree is a real checkout, so a tool deriving ROOT from its own location resolves to the WORKTREE root automatically -- including the hard-wired one, whose upward walk finds the worktree's `config.json`. **The differential is reconstitutable REGARDLESS of whether any tool is parameterised**, and 2290 commits carry the nested layout. **AND THE CHEAP BY-REVISION PATH IS NOT GENERALLY AVAILABLE** (dc, measured): `canon_commit_check.sh` at `ce532a97` returns **rc=2 -- `0 recorded attachment(s), across 0 measured + 57 unmeasurable = 57 thread(s)`**, because many historical revisions record no attachments and correctly refuse. **The worktree is not the tidier route, it is the only reliable one.** **HOW THE FALSE FACT WAS MANUFACTURED, because it is worse than the under-reaching probes and belongs on the record:** vc's probe was `grep -oE 'ROOT=[^ ]*|\$\{?1\}?' | head -2 | tr '\n' ' '`, and **the `tr` JOINED TWO INDEPENDENT MATCHES INTO WHAT READ AS ONE EXPRESSION** -- `ROOT="${ROOT:-$(cd` and a `$1` from a `die()` message elsewhere in the file. **The probe did not merely under-reach; it FABRICATED a syntactic form that appears nowhere in the source**, and vc then stated it with confidence. Reproduced deliberately after the catch. **Sweeping before WP-01 lands would additionally measure cc's IN-FLIGHT patch rather than the landed one -- findings against a tree that never existed.** **THIRD ARM, ON ic's CASE AND IN ic's WORDS: WHERE M CANNOT BE DERIVED, THE TWO NUMBERS MUST BE VISIBLY DIFFERENT KINDS OF NUMBER.** `rig_selftest.sh` prints _drives 18 of the rig's 24 refusal sites_: the **18** is computed from the case table and cannot drift; the **24** is a HAND COUNT of a DIFFERENT artefact's refusal sites, and **no mechanical count reproduces it** -- `exit 2` gives 6, die-calls 42, ic's third probe 30, vc's fourth 47. **Four probes, four answers, none of them 24.** **A criterion demanding derivation would make ic's honest `RECORDED, not measured` label NON-COMPLIANT and push an author toward a bare figure, which is strictly worse** (ic, offering it as an arm rather than as a defect to fix). Derivation is unsatisfiable when M is a property of an artefact nothing enumerates. **SO: derive where derivation is possible; where it is not, LABEL THE RECORDED NUMBER AT THE NUMBER, never in a footnote, so the ratio can never be read without its status -- AND NAME WHAT WOULD DERIVE IT.** The missing definition is stated, because a `RECORDED` with no path to `measured` is a permanent exemption with no work-list, which is the shrunken-roster failure wearing a different hat. **A recorded M is a CLAIM CARRYING NO EVIDENCE, and the reader is entitled to know both that it is one and what would settle it.** **AND THIS INSTANCE IS THE PROOF THAT `10 IS A FLOOR` WAS THE RIGHT READING RATHER THAN A CAUTION.** `rig_selftest.sh`'s 24 carries **no `intent/st` path shape at all**, so dc's two-grep proxy is structurally blind to it -- an ELEVENTH, found by ic from inside the very set that had just adjudicated itself, in a form the nominating probe could not express. **ic ROUTES THEIR OWN TWO**, at their request and on their own bar -- _a closing count must close over what was EXAMINED, never over what EXISTS_ -- which dc's defect instantiates: **if their instruments violate a line they wrote, they should be the one to find it.**

**PROVENANCE OF THIS ROW'S OWN FIGURES (vc 2026-08-19, on findings by ic and dc, neither looking for them).** Two of the figures above are marked `(RECORDED)` under the MEASURED-versus-RECORDED form specified in `data-model.md`: they were observed once and cannot be re-derived. **`EXAMINED 86 of 278` NAMES NO REVISION**, so it is checkable by nobody -- ic reproduced the DEFECT but not the FIGURES (86 of 276, against 84 examined) and could not determine whether this row is wrong or whether it names a revision they had not swept. **`10 of 41`'s NOMINATING PROBE WAS NEVER COMMITTED** -- no tool, no board history carrying its text -- and dc's reconstruction returns 14; `of_n_population.sh` (`f789ae48`) enumerates the population instead. **NEITHER IS REPLACED WITH A CORRECTED NUMBER, DELIBERATELY: a replacement mints a third figure on a fresh decay schedule and retires nothing**, and both peers reached that conclusion independently and declined to supply one. **THIS IS AC-00.11'S OWN THIRD ARM POINTED AT AC-00.11, TWICE, IN THE ROW THAT RULES A FIGURE MUST DERIVE FROM WHAT WAS EXAMINED.** Separately: `10 gated of 17 rostered` and `10 of 41` are two different populations that coincide only in the numeral, so a repeated numeral here reads as a cross-reference while doing no such work.
